title: Meeting recording
description: Whether a meeting's audio is recorded when the client that started it does not say, whether streaming clients may record screen video, and whether a Virtual Participant may record the meeting's video. The default is the shipped value, or the default profile's; a value set here is used instead until it is reset.
appliesText: A saved change applies to streaming meetings that start after the save, and to the next Virtual Participant to start.

recordAudio.title: Record meeting audio
recordAudio.description: Record the audio of meetings streamed to the WebSocket transcriber (the Stream Audio/Video page, the browser extension and the desktop app) unless the client says otherwise, and of meetings a Virtual Participant joins, and store it with the meeting.

recordScreenVideo.title: Record screen video from streaming clients
recordScreenVideo.description: One setting controls screen video from every streaming client: the Stream Audio/Video page, the browser extension and the Desktop Capture App. On: each client offers its users a switch, Also record screen video (in the extension it is off at the start of every meeting; on the page it goes back to off once a meeting has streamed), that also records the screen, window or tab they share (the extension records only the meeting tab); the WebSocket transcriber stores the video with the meeting and keeps its key frames as the meeting's shared-screen slides. Off: the page and the extension offer no video, the transcriber refuses video from every streaming client, the Desktop Capture App tells its user so, and meetings record audio only. Video is recorded only on a deployment with the EnableVideoRecording stack parameter set to true, and only while the meeting's consent allows capture. Virtual Participant video has its own setting, Record Virtual Participant meeting video.

recordVpMeetingVideo.title: Record Virtual Participant meeting video
recordVpMeetingVideo.description: On: a Virtual Participant records the meeting's video (its view of the meeting, with shared screens and camera feeds) as well as the audio, and keeps key frames of the shared screen as the meeting's slides, unless the user who starts it turns Record meeting video off for that meeting. Off: no Virtual Participant records video, whatever its launch asked for; the Create Virtual Participant form shows Record meeting video off and disabled, the Virtual Participant's page says why, and the consent notice has no video sentence. Checked when a Virtual Participant is created and again when it starts, so a scheduled one follows the value saved when it starts. Video is recorded only on a deployment with the EnableVideoRecording stack parameter set to true, whatever this setting says. Screen video from streaming clients has its own setting, Record screen video from streaming clients.
